hook.name: StonkHook
hook.description: A hook that gates swaps via an external `isTradingOpen()` oracle, withholds a configurable fee (up to 5%) from the asset leg of every swap using beforeSwap/afterSwap return-deltas, permanently locks liquidity (any negative liquidityDelta reverts), restricts liquidity additions to the factory only, and overrides the native LP fee to zero via OVERRIDE_FEE_FLAG.
